Contents

On this page

Best Plant Synthetic Biology

This award is designed to celebrate exemplary work done in plant synthetic biology. Did you build a project in a plant chassis? Did you submit plant parts to the Registry?

What iGEM asks for →

Why a plant chassis, and why three systems

Each growth system answers a different question. Say which question each one answers before describing any of them.

Species, cultivar and seed source

Arabidopsis for the controlled work. Name the accession, the seed source, and the sterilisation protocol.

Growth systems

Same species, three environments. Each tab carries its own protocol, its own conditions and its own record.

Agar

Vertical plates for salinity and stress scoring. Medium, plate orientation, day length, temperature, scoring method, and the runs from 2026-05 onward.

Hydroponics

The hydroponic system: vessel, nutrient solution, aeration, replacement schedule, and what it lets you see that agar does not.

Soil

Pot trials: substrate, watering regime, the daily logs, and the trial-by-trial record.

Stress treatments and scoring

Salinity, drought, heat. Define the score before showing any scores, and state who scored blind.

Results across the three systems

Compare like with like, or say plainly why they cannot be compared.

Containment for plant work

Where the plants were grown, who had access, and how material was disposed of. Cross-link to Safety.
